FIELDS.NAME: Garden Grove Inn
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Jessica Taylor, Manager, 123 Elm Street, Garden Grove, CA 90245-1234, (555) 123-4567, jessica.taylor@gardeninn.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Garden Grove Inn, we operate as a cozy bed and breakfast, providing personalized service in a welcoming atmosphere. Our establishment is primarily owner-occupied, ensuring attentive management and guest interaction. We offer complimentary breakfast services daily, which includes a selection of fresh pastries, fruits, and beverages, all thoughtfully prepared with adherence to food safety protocols. 

Our property maintains a strict compliance with local fire safety codes, equipped with modern fire protection systems including alarms and a sprinkler system. We prioritize the comfort and safety of our guests through regular housekeeping and maintenance schedules. The Inn is conveniently located in a secure neighborhood, further enhancing our guests' peace of mind during their stay. At Garden Grove Inn, we are committed to providing a pleasant experience while ensuring a safe and well-maintained environment for all our guests.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 15, 2023, we experienced water damage in two guest rooms due to a burst pipe, resulting in a loss of $5,000 for repairs and cleaning. The damage has been mitigated, and repairs were completed by July 1, 2023.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Commercial Safe, UL Rated, 1-hour fire protection.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24-hour on-site watchperson services to enhance guest safety and property security.
